correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Legendre/Christoffel–Darboux endpoint identity S_n=(-1)^(n+1)n(D_n+D_(n-1))/4 and A_n=(D_n+D_(n-1))/4. The 2-adic reciprocal odd-harmonic lemma v2(sum_(j<=m) 1/(2j-1))=2v2(m) follows pairing, unit-square inverse residues and block sums. In the formal exp(2n h(z)) expansion the r=2 coefficient 2n H_(n/2)^odd has valuation 3v2(n)-1, while r>=4 terms are strictly higher; odd n has odd leading term. Thus exact all-n v2(S_n)=4v2(n)-1 for even n and zero for odd. Independently checked all n<=1024, not an infinite certificate.

evidence: For n divisible by 4, t=v2(n)>=2, set X=n(n+1), Y=n(n-1): X^3-Y^3=2n^3(3n^2+1) has valuation 3t+1; U(X/4) unit and Y^3(U(X/4)-U(Y/4)) divisible by 2^(4t), strictly higher. For n=2 mod4, 8-periodicity mod32 reduces adjacent sums to n=2,6 giving 16 mod32.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The prior pair of exact stronger statements implies v2(D_n+D_(n-1))=3t+1 for ALL even n; the classical endpoint identity then yields the submitted v2(S_n)=4t-1. Odd n follows 4-periodicity mod8 (D_n+D_(n-1) is 4 mod8), so the ENTIRE finding, not only the dyadic subcase, is a corollary.
